title: A Primer of the Quickened Pulse
summary: A first primer for blood-aligned students that teaches how to quicken the pulse into a striking force and how to read a wrist.

title: The Handbook of Vital Flow
summary: A handbook on steering the flow of blood to the fist or the forearm and on easing a cut with a warmed hand.

title: A Workbook of Sanguine Drills
summary: A workbook of short repeatable drills that turn the heartbeat into a blow and a guard for the blood-aligned beginner.

title: The Blood-Reading Primer
summary: A primer that teaches the student to feel another body's pulse and to answer it with thread-thin binding and sharp spray.

title: A Drill-Book for the Steady Heart
summary: A drill-book for steadiness that teaches a calm heartbeat as the base of every guard and every careful blow.

title: A Handbook of Mending Blood
summary: A handbook of gentle healing by borrowed warmth that closes small wounds and lends strength to a tired ally.

title: The Warm Current Workbook
summary: A workbook on heating the blood for a short burst of force and on springing clear of a counter.

title: A Primer on Binding by the Blood
summary: A primer on tethering and slowing an opponent through the pulse and on listening to a heartbeat at a distance.
